part: Terrain-map UI keys (tmap.*), the Report-an-error page and its thanks page, and the UNESCO page

tmap.title.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): H1 of the 3D terrain-map page, also its <title> and breadcrumb name, and the label of the link to it from the regular map page (map.terrain is a separate, already published key). Short noun phrase.

tmap.lead.en: The oasis in relief: Jabal Al-Qarah, the palm groves, and the dunes to the east — with every attraction in place. Tap any name in the list to see it on the map.
tmap.lead.ar: تضاريس الواحة مجسّمة: جبل القارة، وامتداد النخيل، وحافّة الرمال شرقاً — وكل معلم في مكانه. اضغط أي معلم في القائمة ليظهر على الخريطة.
tmap.lead.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Hero lead of the terrain-map page (also its meta description). Names Jabal Al-Qarah, the palm groves and the dunes east of the oasis — all three are termbase terms. «Tap any name in the list» refers to the attraction list printed under the map.

tmap.open.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Button that loads the interactive 3D map (the map is lazy-loaded; before the press only a poster image shows). Imperative.

tmap.loading.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Status text while the map library loads. Ends with an ellipsis.

tmap.3d.on.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Toggle button label that switches the map to 3D (tilted relief). Very short.

tmap.3d.off.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Toggle button label that switches the map back to flat 2D. Very short; must pair with tmap.3d.on.

tmap.locate.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Small button next to each attraction in the list: flies the map to that attraction. Imperative, short.

tmap.list.title.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): H2 above the list of all attractions shown on the map (grouped by category).

tmap.classic.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Link to the ordinary 2D map page (the published key map.* calls that page «map»). An arrow symbol is appended by the template — do not add one.

tmap.gest.win.en: Use Ctrl + scroll to zoom the map
tmap.gest.win.ar: استخدم Ctrl + عجلة الفأرة لتكبير الخريطة
tmap.gest.win.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Overlay hint when a Windows/Linux user scrolls over the map without Ctrl. «Ctrl» stays as the key name.

tmap.gest.mac.en: Use ⌘ + scroll to zoom the map
tmap.gest.mac.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Same hint for macOS; «⌘» stays as the key symbol.

tmap.gest.touch.en: Use two fingers to move the map
tmap.gest.touch.ctx: /de/terrain-map/ (TerrainMapView.astro, ui.ts key): Same hint on touch screens when the user drags the map with one finger.

report.eyebrow.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): small eyebrow line above the H1.

report.title.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): H1 and <title>; the footer link to this page is the published key foot.l.report — keep consistent with it.

report.lead.en: Accuracy is what we care about most. If you spot an inaccurate detail, a broken link or a misplaced photo, tell us and we will review it.
report.lead.ar: دقة المعلومة أهم ما نحرص عليه. إن لاحظت معلومةً غير دقيقة أو رابطاً لا يعمل أو صورةً في غير مكانها، أخبرنا وسنراجعها.
report.lead.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): hero lead paragraph (also meta description).

report.pageL.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): form field label.

report.pagePh.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): placeholder inside the field above (example of what to type).

report.msgL.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): form field label (a question).

report.msgPh.en: Describe the error briefly — and if you know the correct information and its source, add it.
report.msgPh.ar: صف الخطأ بإيجاز — وإن عرفت المعلومة الصحيحة ومصدرها فأضفها.
report.msgPh.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): placeholder inside the message textarea.

report.emailL.en: Your email (optional — if you would like a reply)
report.emailL.ar: بريدك الإلكتروني (اختياري — إن أحببت أن نردّ عليك)
report.emailL.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): form field label; the email is optional — keep that clear.

report.emailPh.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): placeholder — an example email address; keep it exactly as is unless your language needs a different example.

report.submit.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): submit button.

report.note.en: Your report goes straight to the site team; none of it is published.
report.note.ar: يصل بلاغك إلى فريق الموقع مباشرة، ولا يُنشر منه شيء.
report.note.ctx: /de/report/ («Report an error» page — a Netlify form, noindex; ReportView.astro): small print under the button — privacy reassurance.

thanks.title.en: Your report has arrived — thank you
thanks.title.ctx: /de/report/thanks/ (ReportThanksView.astro, noindex): H1 and <title> of the page shown after the error report is sent.

thanks.d.en: The site team will review the note and correct whatever is confirmed. Your contribution keeps the Al-Ahsa guide accurate for everyone.
thanks.d.ar: سيراجع فريق الموقع الملاحظة ويصحح ما يثبت منها. مساهمتك تُبقي دليل الأحساء دقيقاً للجميع.
thanks.d.ctx: /de/report/thanks/ (ReportThanksView.astro, noindex): the paragraph under the H1.

thanks.back.ctx: /de/report/thanks/ (ReportThanksView.astro, noindex): button back to the home page.

unesco.title.en: Al-Ahsa Oasis on the World Heritage List
unesco.title.ar: واحة الأحساء في قائمة التراث العالمي
unesco.title.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): H1 (and JSON-LD list name). The site already publishes, per language, det.unesco and foot.l.unesco (UNESCO badge/footer label) — use the same name for UNESCO and the World Heritage List.

unesco.lead.en: Al-Ahsa Oasis was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List in 2018 (site 1563). The site comprises twelve components; {count} of them are landmarks with their own pages in this guide, listed here in the order of their component numbers on the official list.
unesco.lead.ar: سُجّلت واحة الأحساء على قائمة اليونسكو للتراث العالمي عام 2018 (الموقع رقم 1563)، ويتألف الموقع من اثني عشر مكوّناً. {count} منها معالم بصفحات مفردة في هذا الدليل — مرتّبةً هنا بأرقام مكوّناتها كما في القائمة الرسمية.
unesco.lead.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): hero lead. {count} is replaced at build time by the number of components with their own page in this guide (today 6) — keep {count} literally once and write the sentence so it is grammatical with that number. Facts: inscribed 2018, site number 1563, twelve components.

unesco.comp.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): small label before each component number on the cards, e.g. «Component 1563-004».

unesco.officialH.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): H2 of the box that sends readers to UNESCO.

unesco.official.en: The full list of the twelve components and their maps is on the site’s page at the UNESCO World Heritage Centre.
unesco.official.ar: القائمة الكاملة للمكوّنات الاثني عشر وخرائطها في صفحة الموقع على منصة مركز التراث العالمي لليونسكو.
unesco.official.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): text of that box.

unesco.officialLink.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): external link label to whc.unesco.org; the template keeps the trailing ↗ from the source — keep it.

unesco.seoTitle.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): the page <title> (short).

unesco.seoDesc.en: {count} of the twelve components of the Al-Ahsa Oasis UNESCO World Heritage site (2018) with their own pages: {names}.
unesco.seoDesc.ar: {count} من مكوّنات موقع واحة الأحساء الاثني عشر في قائمة اليونسكو للتراث العالمي (2018) بصفحات مفردة: {names}.
unesco.seoDesc.ctx: /de/unesco/ («Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO» page, UnescoView.astro): meta description. {count} = number of components with pages (6); {names} = their names joined by the language list separator, inserted at build time — keep both placeholders literally once, and end the sentence right after {names}.
